newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares' correction phase seen persisting.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares' correction phase seen persisting.

text.p: Danish share prices closed lower on Tuesday continuing their current phase of correction on top of the last weeks of major advances with dealers seeing more falls in the pipeline.
"I think we are going to see more sideways or downward movement in the market tomorrow, even if the Dow rises moderately by New York's close tonight as it looks like doing," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index lost 1.00 point to 151.47, its second consecutive fall, while the KFX March future fell 1.05 point to 150.85 with 260 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
Profit-taking hit leading banks and Tele Danmark. Den Danske Bank finished nine crowns down at 554, while rival Unidanmark shed seven crowns to close at 345.
Tele Danmark suffered less of a setback, losing only two crowns to end the day at 364.
Road contractor Phoenix rose 15 crowns to 655 as the takeover bid war for the company continued with a new offer from Norway's Rieber.
Overall turnover for the day was 1.118 billion crowns.
